title: Hostel council
summary: Hostel Student Body, GBM, council members and each secretary's duties.

posts.md:
Every hostel at IIT Madras has its own **Hostel Council**, which represents the residents of that hostel and manages hostel-level activities, facilities, and student life.

The Hostel Council works closely with the **Hostel Student Body (HSB)**, the Warden, and the Assistant Warden to ensure the smooth functioning of the hostel.

## Hostel Student Body (HSB)

The **Hostel Student Body (HSB)** consists of all residents of a hostel.

It plays an important role in hostel governance by discussing important issues and approving major hostel decisions.

### Responsibilities

Discuss hostel-related issues

Decide hostel policies

Approve the hostel budget

Review the performance of the Hostel Council

## General Body Meeting (GBM)

The General Body Meeting is where hostel residents collectively discuss and decide important matters.

During a GBM, students can:

- Discuss hostel issues

- Approve hostel policies

- Pass the annual hostel budget

- Review the work of the Hostel Council

Every hostel holds at least **one GBM each semester**, chaired by the Warden.

## Hostel Council

The Hostel Council is responsible for implementing hostel policies and coordinating student activities within the hostel.

### Members

Hostel Legislator

General Secretary

Sports Secretary

Literary Secretary

Social Secretary

Technical Affairs Secretary

Health & Hygiene Secretary

The Hostel Council regularly meets with the Warden to discuss improvements, student concerns, and hostel development.

## Hostel Secretaries

Each Hostel Secretary looks after a specific aspect of hostel life.

**General Secretary**
- Hostel administration
- Hostel maintenance
- Security
- Coordination of all hostel secretaries

**Sports Secretary**
- Sports equipment
- Intra-hostel tournaments
- Inter-hostel sports participation

**Literary Secretary**
- Hostel library
- Books & newspapers
- Literary activities

**Social Secretary**
- Festivals & social events
- Cultural activities
- Musical instruments
- Audio/video facilities

**Technical Affairs Secretary**
- Technical events
- Computers & equipment
- Inter-hostel technical competitions

**Health & Hygiene Secretary**
- Hostel cleanliness
- Water quality
- Medical emergencies
- Waste management
- Garden maintenance
- Mess-related issues

## Hostel Governance at a Glance

```text
Hostel Student Body (HSB)
│
├── General Body Meeting
│
└── Hostel Council
    │
    ├── Hostel Legislator
    ├── General Secretary
    ├── Sports Secretary
    ├── Literary Secretary
    ├── Social Secretary
    ├── Technical Affairs Secretary
    └── Health & Hygiene Secretary
```

**Did you know?**

Unlike institute-level student governance, **every hostel has its own elected Hostel Council** that manages day-to-day student life, organizes activities, addresses hostel concerns, and represents residents before the Warden and the institute.
